jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - CIA
jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures,  we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.
 
Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.
 
About the Role
The Staff Product Manager – Platform will own critical platform capabilities that underpin every CaptivateIQ customer experience: Compliance, Identity, and Authorization (CIA). 
 
This role is responsible for defining and delivering the strategy, roadmap, and execution for core account and platform capabilities, including authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, and compliance-related features. These systems ensure our platform is secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready.
 
You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Product, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market partners to build foundational platform capabilities and deliver meaningful business impact. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of platform architecture, risk management, and customer trust.
 
Job Location
Remote 

Responsibilities
- Product Strategy & Vision

- Own the long-term vision and strategy for compliance, identity, and authorization across the CaptivateIQ platform

- Translate company, customer, and regulatory needs into a clear, prioritized product roadmap

- Anticipate future scale, enterprise, and ecosystem requirements, and incorporate them into long-term platform investments

- Customer Advocacy & Impact

- Serve as the voice of the customer by deeply understanding customer needs and ensuring those insights are broadly understood across the organization

- Translate customer needs into clear investment areas and high-impact deliverables with measurable business outcomes

- Proactively identify platform gaps that could introduce risk or limit enterprise adoption

- Platform Stewardship

- Advocate for platform consistency, reuse, and developer experience; empower CIQ to more efficiently build multiple products and lines of businesses.

- Improve internal product surfaces, APIs, and tooling that other teams build upon

- Set standards and best practices for platform product management across the org

- Product Execution Excellence

- Lead discovery, definition, and delivery of platform capabilities in partnership with Engineering and Design

- Write clear product requirements that balance security, usability, and extensibility

- Make principled tradeoffs between short-term needs and long-term platform health

- Ensure high-quality delivery through strong backlog management, sequencing, and scope ownership

- Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as a trusted partner to Engineering, influencing technical direction while respecting architectural ownership

- Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Support to understand customer needs and unblock enterprise deals

- Influence without authority by driving clarity, alignment, and decision-making across teams
Must haves
- 8+ years of product management experience, with significant time spent on platform, infrastructure, or technical products

- Strong technical fluency; comfortable partnering with senior engineers on system design and tradeoffs

- Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives without direct authority

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for ambiguous or high-risk problem spaces

- Track record of delivering durable, scalable platform capabilities in a SaaS environment

- Direct experience owning compliance, identity, authorization, or Security related product areas
Benefits: 
- Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.

- Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.

- Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.

- Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.

- Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.

- Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.

- Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.
Notice to Prospective Candidates: 
- Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.

- We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.

- Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.

- Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.

- Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.

- Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.

- Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Modeling Platform
jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize the models that run their business. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, expanded into sales planning, and are building a unified platform for the most critical models an enterprise runs.
CaptivateIQ is looking for a Staff Product Manager – Modeling Platform to define and evolve the foundational modeling capabilities that power products across CaptivateIQ.
Our customers use CaptivateIQ to represent complex business logic: how sales teams earn commissions, how organizations plan headcount and expenses, how revenue is forecast, and how businesses evaluate different scenarios. While these use cases look different on the surface, they depend on many of the same underlying concepts: data, relationships, calculations, models, versions, scenarios, and outputs.
Your job is to turn those concepts into coherent, extensible modeling platform capabilities.
You will work at the intersection of product architecture, data modeling, and user experience, partnering deeply with Engineering, Design, and product teams across CaptivateIQ. You’ll determine what belongs in the shared platform versus individual products, define durable primitives and contracts that multiple teams can build upon, and evolve those abstractions as we expand into new modeling domains.
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for a product leader who loves complex systems, can move fluidly between customer workflows and technical architecture, and knows how to simplify complexity without removing the flexibility sophisticated users need.

What You'll Own
The Modeling Platform is the shared foundation for representing and executing business models across CaptivateIQ.

Your scope will include capabilities such as:

-
Modeling primitives. Define the foundational concepts used to represent models, including objects, relationships, inputs, calculations, outputs, components, dimensions, measures, and other reusable building blocks.

-
Model structure and composition. Enable customers and product teams to construct sophisticated models from reusable, composable pieces rather than bespoke product-specific logic.

-
State and planning concepts. Establish consistent ways to represent concepts such as actuals, forecasts, versions, and scenarios across modeling use cases.

-
Cross-model interoperability. Define how data, assumptions, calculations, and outputs can be shared and referenced across models and products.

-
Modeling interfaces and contracts. Partner with Engineering to define clear schemas, APIs, behaviors, and guarantees that product teams can reliably build upon.

-
AI-ready modeling. Ensure models have the structure, semantics, and interfaces necessary for agents to understand, create, explain, and safely modify them.

Your job is not to design a modeling system for one product. It is to create the foundation that allows CaptivateIQ to represent many different kinds of business models without rebuilding the modeling paradigm each time.
What You'll Do
-
Own the Modeling Platform strategy and roadmap. Define the foundational capabilities and primitives that enable CaptivateIQ to represent complex business models across products and domains.

-
Define durable platform abstractions. Identify common needs across products and determine what belongs in the shared platform versus the consuming product, where abstraction boundaries should sit, and how those capabilities should evolve over time.

-
Partner deeply with Engineering. Work closely with senior and staff+ engineers on data models, schemas, APIs, system behavior, performance constraints, and architectural tradeoffs.

-
Ground platform decisions in real modeling problems. Understand how customers represent data, relationships, assumptions, calculations, business logic, scenarios, and outputs across domains such as incentive compensation, sales planning, and FP&A.

-
Connect platform architecture to product experience. Partner with Design and product teams to turn powerful underlying capabilities into intuitive modeling experiences for business users.

-
Drive alignment across teams. Bring together Product, Engineering, Design, and domain experts to work through complex problems, surface tradeoffs, and make decisions that create leverage across CaptivateIQ.

-
Build for an AI-native future. Ensure our modeling platform has the structure, semantics, and interfaces necessary for agents to understand and interact with models while maintaining deterministic execution at its core.
What You'll Bring
-
8+ years of product management experience, ideally with platform, data, modeling, analytics, or other technically complex products.

-
A track record of building shared platform capabilities used across multiple products, teams, or use cases.

-
Strong technical fluency and the ability to partner deeply with senior engineers on architecture and system design.

-
Experience with or a strong understanding of modeling systems , including how data, relationships, calculations, and business logic come together to represent real-world systems.

-
Excellent cross-functional leadership , with a track record of driving clarity and decisions across Engineering, Design, Product, and other stakeholders.

-
Strong judgment and communication skills, particularly when navigating ambiguous problems and complex tradeoffs.
Nice to Have
- Experience with enterprise modeling, planning, analytics, BI, data platforms, spreadsheets, or developer platforms.

-
Familiarity with FP&A, sales planning, incentive compensation, workforce planning, or adjacent enterprise planning domains.

-
Experience with semantic layers, calculation engines, data modeling systems, workflow engines, or low-code/no-code platforms.

-
Experience building platforms designed to support AI or agent interactions.
